messages:
maria: Heads-up — eu-west1 control plane weirdness. apiserver 503 spike starting ~09:04 UTC, watch queue depth climbing. Not seeing GPU pool impact yet but leader heartbeat jitter on the controller-manager metrics. Possibly proxy/NAT pressure.

sre-bot: ALERT: apiserver_503_rate > 5% in eu-west1 (09:04). watch_queue_depth > 500 for controllers.

ajay: Saw leader flips in etcd around same time (leader change logs). Posting quick tail of etcd logs:
```
2024-11-06T09:03:58Z raft: lost leader; term=124
2024-11-06T09:04:02Z raft: elected leader id=etcd-2
2024-11-06T09:04:10Z raft: lost leader; term=124
```

liam: Hmm, if leader is flapping that could blow up watch fanout. Any NAT conntrack metrics on the proxy NGINX / calico nodes?

olivia: conntrack table for the nat gateway in eu-west1 shows 99% -> dropping new entries. kernel dmesg has conntrack: table full logs.

ajay: That matches. When conntrack saturates, we see half-open TCPs and apiserver clients (kubelets/controllers) drop connections -> 503s + lots of reconnects -> etcd leader timeouts.

maria: TL;DR seems like cross-AZ proxy doing SNAT and losing conntrack entries during a small surge (control-plane reconciles + a scheduled rollout). Could be rollout+promote events.

liam: Immediate mitigation ideas: 1) bump conntrack max on gateway (sysctl) 2) temporarily route control-plane traffic through standby proxies in same AZ 3) throttle the rollout spike (pause canary).

olivia: Increasing nf_conntrack_max looks safe short-term. I'm SSHing to nat-gw-01 and setting sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=300000 now.

maria: Can we also rollback the large k8s rollout in eu-west1? I see a deployment scaling from 50 -> 250 pods starting at 09:02. That's probably the spike.

ajay: On it — pausing the rollout and scaling the deployment back to 60 via kubectl scale.

deploy-bot: Deployment/ingest-api paused by ajay at 09:06 UTC.

liam: After nf_conntrack bump, conntrack usage dropped and new entries are being accepted. apiserver 503 rate falling from 8% -> 1.2% in the last 30s. watch queue depth also trending down.

olivia: Filed a follow-up infra ticket to increase conntrack defaults for eu-west1 gateways and add alerting for conntrack > 80%.

maria: Action items: 1) permanant conntrack config change + restart plan (infra) 2) adjust rollout throttling for eu regions (platform) 3) investigate why rollout caused such burst (product). I'll open RFCs.

ajay: Note: etcd leader logs show short-term leader elections but raft settled after traffic subdued. No data loss.

maria: Thanks everyone. Marking incident as mitigated for now — will keep monitoring for 1h. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: INCIDENT mitigated (09:07 UTC). Monitoring for regression.
